change: Add precision highp int inside GL_ES fragment precision block. No equations, time calculation, N64 pattern or periodicity changed.
classification: Portability risk addressed, not an observed device failure.

facts: GLSL ES100 fragment integer default is mediump. This shader previously specified only highp float.
ES100 minimum mediump int range is (-2^10,2^10); highp is optional in fragments and guarantees at least (-2^16,2^16). The existing shader already requires fragment highp float.
A universal failure after32767frames cannot be inferred from these declarations. Actual ranges can be greater and queried at runtime.
ANGLE queried mediump and highp integer ranges are equal [31,30]; no reduced-precision failure reproduced in this local environment.

tests.environment: Local Windows ANGLE NVIDIA D3D11 pbuffer; not Android
tests.isolatedClockArithmeticResult: RGBA readback exactly matched expected four channels for every sample; glGetError=0

limits: Highp selection does not claim unlimited duration or support for every minimum-spec ES2 implementation. No runtime modulo/wrap change introduced.
